description:
## 0.1.0

- Pure black dark-mode surfaces in Wallapop's Compose LinkColors palette.
- Android system dark-mode selection and semantic night resources for legacy UI.
- Central advertising eligibility gates disabled.
- Targets com.wallapop 1.334.0 (10141414), patcher 1.15.1.
- Compiled bundle and APK rebuild verified. Visual behaviour and startup on a phone remain unverified; PairIP can affect modified APK startup.

patches.name: Wallapop No Ads
patches.description: Disables Wallapop's central advertising eligibility gates. Does not unlock subscriptions or remove promoted marketplace listings.

patches.name: Wallapop OLED dark mode
patches.description: Uses pure black for dark-mode Compose surfaces and themed legacy backgrounds. Preserves the original light palette, brand colours, text and icons. Follows Android dark mode.
